### Peer Review

| Aspect | Detail |
|--------|--------|
| **Type** | Double blind: the live instructions say that once the editor has assessed suitability the paper is "double blind peer reviewed by independent, anonymous expert referees", and warn that anonymity cannot be guaranteed for a manuscript already on a preprint server (https://www.tandfonline.com/action/authorSubmission?journalCode=casp20&page=instructions, read 2026-11-24). The live about page says all research articles have undergone peer review "based on initial editor screening and anonymized refereeing by at least two anonymous referees" (https://www.tandfonline.com/journals/casp20/about-this-journal, read 2026-11-24). ## Format

> Source for the general rules: the journal's live instructions for authors (https://www.tandfonline.com/action/authorSubmission?journalCode=casp20&page=instructions), read in a real browser on 2026-11-24; the page prints no date. Retrieved 2026-11-24. The Wayback copy of 2022-12-25 is older; rows that rest only on it say so.

| Aspect | Detail |
|--------|--------|
| **Article types accepted** | The instructions list one type: original articles; manuscripts in English only. OpenAlex types for 2021-01-01 to 2026-11-23: 180 articles and 1 obituary, no book reviews (181 records) |
| **Word limit** | "A typical paper for this journal should be no more than 10,000 words, inclusive of the abstract, tables, references, figure captions, endnotes" (live instructions, read 2026-11-24; same figure in the 2022-12-25 copy) |
| **Word limit negotiability** | Blank. The live instructions word it as a typical-paper ceiling; no statement on exceptions found |
| **Abstract limit** | Unstructured abstract of 150 words (live instructions, read 2026-11-24). The 4 to 5 keywords of the 2022-12-25 copy were not found in the passages of the live page read |
| **Reference limit** | No separate cap; references count inside the 10,000 words. The instructions link a reference guide without naming the style in the text read |
| **Supplementary material** | Supplemental material (video, dataset, files) is published via Figshare (instructions, 2022-12-25) |
| **Figure/Table limits** | No count limit found. Figure resolution: 1200 dpi line art, 600 dpi greyscale, 300 dpi colour; editable tables (instructions, 2022-12-25) |
| **Style / submission format** | Any spelling style if consistent; single quotation marks, long quotations indented; Word submissions, with a template available; Crossref similarity screening of all submissions (instructions, 2022-12-25) |
| **Submission route** | Direct e-mail to the editor named in the copy of 2022-12-25 (see Identity for why that contact may be out of date); the page menus also carry a "Submit an article" entry that was not followed |
| **Data sharing** | Taylor & Francis Basic Data Sharing Policy: sharing is encouraged, a data availability statement is encouraged, and data sets are not peer reviewed (instructions, 2022-12-25) |

### Framing Requirements

- **Mandatory framing?** The stated scope is Indian, Chinese, Japanese, Buddhist and Islamic philosophical traditions, central areas of philosophy and comparison of Eastern and Western traditions; the aims copy also quotes a testimonial praising hospitality to Jewish, Islamic and Persian traditions, which is the page's own text and not a stated editorial rule (https://web.archive.org/web/20221224024909/https://www.tandfonline.com/action/journalInformation?show=aimsScope&journalCode=casp20, copy 2022-12-24). Count check: none of the 178 abstracts matches `\b(?:Jewish|Judaism)\b` (0 of 178), so that testimonial is not borne out in 2021-2026 abstracts.
- **What kind of engagement?** Philosophical analysis of an Asian tradition, alone or compared with Western thought: `\b(?:conceptual|theoretical|reconstruct(?:s|ion|ive)?)\b` 11.8% and comparison vocabulary 12.9% of 178 abstracts (Orientation).
- **Article type and length**: original articles only, in English, up to about 10,000 words including references and endnotes, with an unstructured 150-word abstract and 4 to 5 keywords (instructions copy 2022-12-25, https://web.archive.org/web/20221225040847/https://www.tandfonline.com/action/authorSubmission?show=instructions&journalCode=casp20).
- **Conditions**: the manuscript must be original, not under consideration elsewhere, and contain nothing abusive, defamatory, libellous, obscene, fraudulent or illegal; all submissions undergo Crossref similarity screening (same instructions copy).
- **Consequences of ignoring it**: Blank. No source states what happens to out-of-scope submissions, and no desk-rejection data exists (SciRev has no reviews, https://scirev.org/reviews/asian-philosophy/).

### Methodological Preferences

> Scoring convention of this research pass (its own, not an external standard): share of the 178 abstract-bearing OpenAlex articles (2021-01-01 to 2026-11-23) matching the regex in title or abstract; 0 hits = 0; under 1% = 1; 1-5% = 2; over 5% = 3; 4-5 only with a cited editorial statement, and none was found. Scores measure how often a method appears, not how a reviewer would judge it. Regexes are case-insensitive with word boundaries, written in the Orientation section. Retrieved 2026-11-23, OpenAlex works API.

| Mixed methods | 0 | `\bmixed[- ]methods?\b` 0 of 178 |
| Meta-analysis / systematic review | 0 | `\b(?:meta-analysis|systematic review|scoping review)\b` 0 of 178 |
| Comparative philosophy (added row) | 3 | `\b(?:comparative|comparison|compare(?:s|d)?|comparing)\b` 23 of 178 (12.9%); title-only 2 of 180 (1.1%); comparison of Eastern and Western traditions is in the stated scope (aims copy 2022-12-24) |

### Voice & Style

| Aspect | Detail |
|--------|--------|
| **First-person voice acceptance (0-5)** | Not scored. Of the 178 abstracts, 94 (52.8%) contain a first-person form: `\b(I|my)\b(?! (?:Am|Ching))` (case-sensitive) matches 63 and `\b(we|our)\b` (case-sensitive) matches 47, overlapping; plural "we" may be generic and "I" can match a Roman numeral, so these are upper bounds. The narrower `\bI (?:argue|examine|show|contend|suggest|propose|will|claim|explore|discuss|defend|seek|aim|analy[sz]e|maintain|offer|present)\b` matches 43 (24.2%). Recent openings use "This paper argues ..." and "This article reconstructs ..." (e.g. https://doi.org/10.1080/09552367.2026.2661483, https://doi.org/10.1080/09552367.2026.2646602). The instructions give no first-person rule |
| **Expected density** | Length ceiling about 10,000 words including abstract, tables, references, figure captions and endnotes (live instructions, read 2026-11-24, https://www.tandfonline.com/action/authorSubmission?journalCode=casp20&page=instructions) |
| **Abstract and keywords** | Unstructured abstract of 150 words (live instructions, read 2026-11-24); the 2022-12-25 copy also gave 4 to 5 keywords, not found in the live passages read |
| **Writing style notes** | Any spelling style if consistent; single quotation marks except for a quotation within a quotation; long quotations indented without quotation marks; authors told to follow the quick style guidelines rather than published articles. The same page lists a generic empirical section order (introduction, materials and methods, results, discussion) that is publisher template text; empirical vocabulary is in 6 of 178 abstracts, so most articles are unlikely to follow that order (article structure was not sampled) |
| **Authorship pattern** | OpenAlex authorships of the 180 articles (2021-01-01 to 2026-11-23): 163 single-author (90.6%), 16 two-author (8.9%), 1 three-author (0.6%) |

Board counts are taken from the live journal page (https://www.tandfonline.com/journals/casp20/about-this-journal, read in a real browser 2026-11-24; the list is labelled "Updated 28-10-2026"). The earlier copy of 2025-01-05 (labelled "Updated 09-01-2024") is kept below as older.

| Aspect | Detail | Evidence |
|--------|--------|----------|
| **Board size and roles** | 25 entries under 3 headings: editor 1, associate editors 3, editorial advisory board 21 (1 + 3 + 21 = 25) | Live about page (board block "Updated 28-10-2026"), counted 2026-11-24; the 2025-01-05 copy had the same 25 |

### Practical Concerns

| Concern | Detail |

| **IRB requirement strictness** | Blank for any journal-specific ethics-approval rule: the instructions copy (2022-12-25) points to the publisher's general publishing-ethics guidance and has no journal-specific IRB text. The work is mostly non-empirical by vocabulary (empirical terms in 6 of 178 abstracts, see Orientation), but that is not an ethics rule |
| **Single-author acceptance** | 163 of 180 articles (90.6%) are single-author (OpenAlex works API, 2021-01-01 to 2026-11-23) |
| **Independent scholar friendliness** | Affiliation rule: the instructions ask for author affiliations, defined as where the research was conducted, on the cover page (https://web.archive.org/web/20221225040847/https://www.tandfonline.com/action/authorSubmission?show=instructions&journalCode=casp20). No independent-scholar clause was found |
| **Data transparency requirement** | Basic data-sharing policy: sharing and a data availability statement are encouraged, not required (same instructions copy) |
| **OPSEC compatibility** | Double-blind review with author names and affiliations on the cover page; a manuscript on a preprint server loses any anonymity guarantee (same instructions copy); pre-submission preprints are allowed by the publisher (https://authorservices.taylorandfrancis.com/research-impact/sharing-versions-of-journal-articles/) |
| **AI use** | Disclosure statement naming tool, version, use and reason; AI cannot be an author (https://taylorandfrancis.com/our-policies/ai-policy/), retrieved 2026-11-23 |
| **Open access and cost** | Hybrid via Open Select; no submission fee or page charges in the 2022 instructions copy; APC amount not read (https://authorservices.taylorandfrancis.com/publishing-open-access/open-select/). 19 of 181 recent records are hybrid open access in OpenAlex |
| **Originality screening** | All submissions are screened with Crossref similarity checking and must not be under consideration elsewhere (instructions copy 2022-12-25) |

## Strategic Notes

> Each statement below follows from a fact recorded above and names it. Where the evidence does not support a statement, the field says so.

### Hard Blockers

- **Scope**: the work must concern one of the Asian philosophical traditions in the aims (Indian, Chinese, Japanese, Buddhist, Islamic) or compare Eastern and Western traditions (Framing Requirements; aims copy 2022-12-24). A paper with no Asian-tradition component is outside the stated scope.
- **Language and type**: English only, original articles only (instructions copy 2022-12-25; these sentences were not located in the live page text read on 2026-11-24).
- **Length**: a typical paper should not exceed 10,000 words, references and endnotes included (Format, live instructions read 2026-11-24); whether exceptions are granted is not stated.
- **Exclusivity and originality**: the manuscript must not be under consideration elsewhere and is screened for similarity (Framing Requirements).
- **AI use**: undisclosed generative-AI use, or generated text submitted without rigorous revision, breaches the publisher policy (AI Policy).
- No other hard blocker is supported by a fact I could read; ethics-approval rules are not stated in the passages of the live instructions read (Practical Concerns).

### Soft Tax

- **Submission contact uncertainty**: the 2022 instructions name an editor for whom the journal published an obituary in February 2023, so the current route has to be confirmed on the live page before sending (Identity).
- **Time**: no review-time figure exists (Review Cycle Time); the only datum is a single 2014 anecdote of acceptance after a few months, and the publisher states 7 days from acceptance to online.
- **Open-access cost**: green deposit after an embargo whose length was not read; gold open access carries an APC whose amount was not read (Open Access, Preprint Policy).
- **Anonymisation**: double-blind review with author details on the cover page; a preprint removes any anonymity guarantee (Peer Review, Practical Concerns).

### Best Suited For

- Conceptual and interpretive work on Chinese, Buddhist or Indian traditions: Confucian 26.4%, Daoist 25.8%, Buddhist 18.0%, Indian terms 7.9%, conceptual vocabulary 11.8% of 178 abstracts (Epistemological & Political Leanings, Orientation).
- Comparative papers that read an Asian tradition against Western figures: comparison vocabulary 12.9% and Western names 16.9% of abstracts (Methodological Preferences, Epistemological).
- Papers on Islamic and Persian philosophy as well as Japanese philosophy: Islamic-Persian terms 7.9% and Japanese terms 6.2% of abstracts (Epistemological). For comparison, the Dao entry in this corpus counts Japanese, Islamic and Indian terms at 0, 1 and 0 of 179 articles (see [dao.md](dao.md)).
- Sole-authored essays: 163 of 180 articles are single-author (Voice & Style).

### Not Recommended For

- Empirical, interview-based or quantitative studies: quantitative vocabulary in 6 of 178 abstracts and interview or ethnography vocabulary in 0 (Methodological Preferences). The counts show these are rare here, not that they are rejected.
- Systematic reviews and meta-analyses: 0 of 178 abstracts (Methodological Preferences).
- Book reviews: the journal's instructions list original articles only and OpenAlex shows no book reviews in the window (Format).
- Papers on Jewish or Korean philosophy if matching recent output matters: 0 and 1 of 178 abstracts (Epistemological & Political Leanings); the aims do not exclude them.
- Authors who need a verified turnaround or acceptance rate before choosing: none exists in any source read (Metrics, Review Cycle Time).

### Rejection Fallback Chain

> No source states where rejected authors usually go. The rows below are topical neighbours that exist in this corpus; they are not a claim about acceptance odds.

| Rank | Journal | Why this fallback works |
|------|---------|------------------------|
| 1 | [Philosophy East and West](philosophy-east-and-west.md) | Same subject area (comparative and Asian philosophy); an entry exists in this corpus. No fit evidence collected here |
| 2 | [Journal of Chinese Philosophy](journal-of-chinese-philosophy.md) | Same subject area for Chinese-tradition work; an entry exists in this corpus. No fit evidence collected here |
| 3 | [Dao: A Journal of Comparative Philosophy](dao.md) | Same subject area (Chinese and comparative philosophy); an entry exists in this corpus. No fit evidence collected here |
